tools.name: list_courses
tools.description:
List Epivo's public course catalogue, grouped by curriculum source.

    Args:
        audience: optional filter, "k12" or "adult".
        language: optional filter, e.g. "English", "Swedish", "Greek", "Arabic"
            (display name, matching the "language" field of each result).

    Returns t

tools.name: get_course_detail
tools.description:
Get the individual courses within one curriculum source.

    Args:
        slug: the curriculum source's slug, as returned by list_courses.

    Returns the same shape as GET /api/v1/public/courses-detail/<slug>.

tools.name: get_catalog_stats
tools.description:
Get aggregate catalogue counts (courses, curricula, languages, knowledge components).

    Returns the same shape as GET /api/v1/public/stats.
